definitions.explanation: Soy sauce that is paler in color than the standard {濃口|こいくち} but actually contains more salt. Used to season dishes without darkening their color. Especially common in Kansai cuisine.

examples.japanese: {薄口|うすくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄口|うすくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Light soy sauce is often used in Kansai cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つゆ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{透明感|とうめいかん}→透明感：18903_toumeikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薄口|うすくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Light soy sauce is essential for giving udon broth its clear, light color.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (light, pale) + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth, flavor). The name refers to color, not saltiness — {薄口|うすくち} actually has higher salt content than ⟦{濃口|こいくち}→濃口：27553_koikuchi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄口|うすくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}: light soy sauce
- {薄口|うすくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to simmer with light soy sauce
- {薄口|うすくち}⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立て：11645_shitate⟧: prepared with light soy sauce

COMMON MISCONCEPTION:
{薄口|うすくち} ("light") refers only to color and aroma — the salt content is roughly 10% higher than ⟦{濃口|こいくち}→濃口：27553_koikuchi⟧. Use less by volume than you would standard soy sauce.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{濃口|こいくち}→濃口：27553_koikuchi⟧: dark soy sauce — standard, most common
- {白醤油|しろじょうゆ}: white soy sauce — even paler than {薄口|うすくち}
- ⟦たまり{醤油|じょうゆ}→たまり醤油：27593_tamarijouyu⟧: tamari — thick and rich
